metadata.description: The native shell conformance rows (T02, E rows a provider owns): the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, network negatives judged by canaries outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Never cached: a receipt is only evidence of the run that wrote it.

The private Linux projection transport rows: builds the unqualified FUSE bridge from explicitly supplied pinned libfuse 3.17.2 headers and library (TAU_PROJECTION_NODE_HEADERS, TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_HEADERS, TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_LIBRARY, TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_SHA256), then runs the native transport tests against a real kernel FUSE mount, and the host's test-only owner harness that publishes the PP3 spelling families through a held rooted claim (G5). Proves transport and outbound classification only, never the production owner or D8 activation. Never cached.
